name.zh: Juns Go 分享链接清洗器
name.en: Juns Go share-link cleaner

summary.zh: 粘贴小红书、闲鱼、淘宝等 App 的分享文案，得到一条干净短链；手机点开直接唤起对应 App，电脑端显示扫码二维码。
summary.en: Paste share text from apps like Xiaohongshu, Xianyu or Taobao and get a clean short link that opens the app on phones and shows a QR code on desktop.

name.zh: zsctl：极空间 NAS 命令行
name.en: zsctl: ZSpace NAS CLI

summary.zh: 用命令行和 Agent Skill 管理极空间 NAS：Docker 容器、存储池、硬盘休眠诊断和下载任务。
summary.en: A CLI and agent skill for ZSpace NAS: Docker containers, storage pools, disk-sleep diagnostics and downloads.

name.zh: Crisp：crispctl 命令行控制
name.en: Crisp: crispctl controls

summary.zh: 给 macOS 显示器工具 Crisp 提交的 4 个 PR，均已合并：本地控制入口、显示器信息、Extra Brightness 和外接 HDR 开关。
summary.en: Four merged PRs to the macOS display app Crisp: a local control socket, display metadata, Extra Brightness and external HDR controls.

name.zh: RClick：多级右键菜单与外接盘
name.en: RClick: nested menus and mounted volumes

summary.zh: 给 macOS 右键菜单工具 RClick 提交的 2 个 PR，均已合并：用 JSON 声明多级菜单；外接盘和网络盘挂载后也能用右键菜单。
summary.en: Two merged PRs to the macOS Finder menu app RClick: JSON-declared nested menus, and support for external and network volumes.

name.zh: Paseo：OMP 冷启动超时
name.en: Paseo: OMP cold-start timeout

summary.zh: 给多 Agent 编排工具 Paseo 提交的 PR，已合并：OMP 冷启动等待从 10 秒放宽到 20 秒，显式配置的超时同时作用于启动和后续调用。
summary.en: A merged PR to the multi-agent orchestrator Paseo: OMP's cold-start ready wait goes from 10 to 20 seconds, and a configured timeout now covers both startup and later RPCs.

name.zh: bb：矮窗口下模型选择器可滚动
name.en: bb: scrollable model picker

summary.zh: 给 Agent IDE bb 提交的 PR，已合并：窗口高度不够时，模型选择列表仍可滚动选到底部选项。
summary.en: A merged PR to the agent IDE bb: the model picker stays scrollable when the window is short.

name.zh: 三角洲《胜者为王》地图轮换
name.en: Delta Force map rotation

summary.zh: 选一个日期，查看当天及之后 7 天的地图轮换；可以标记偏好地图。数据只覆盖 S10 赛季（至 2026-11-04）。
summary.en: Pick a date to see the map rotation for that day and the next seven, with favourite maps highlighted. Covers season S10 only (until 2026-11-04).

name.zh: Evidence Ledger：证据简报生成器
name.en: Evidence Ledger

summary.zh: 读取本地 JSON 证据包，保留原始链接并去重，按事实、个人体验、推断和待核验缺口分区生成 Markdown 简报。不负责联网搜索。
summary.en: Turns a local JSON evidence bundle into a Markdown brief that keeps source links and separates facts, experiences, inferences and coverage gaps. It does not search the web.

name.zh: Monocode Paseo：原生桌面客户端
name.en: Monocode Paseo: native desktop client

summary.zh: 基于 MonoCode 的个人实验 fork，用原生 GPUI 界面连接本机 Paseo，两边复用同一批对话与历史，可以接着聊。需要本机 Paseo，不保证兼容性与稳定性。
summary.en: A personal experimental MonoCode fork: a native GPUI interface for a local Paseo daemon, sharing conversations and history across both clients. Requires local Paseo; no compatibility or stability guarantees.

name.zh: mac-unlock：Mac 锁屏解锁助手
name.en: mac-unlock

summary.zh: 本地 Agent 被 Mac 普通锁屏卡住时，按需调起原生窗口输入密码，并返回 JSON 回执。公开版尚未重新做实机测试。
summary.en: When a local agent is blocked by an ordinary Mac lock screen, it opens a native prompt for the password and returns a JSON receipt. The public build has not been re-tested on a real machine.

name.zh: android-unlock：安卓锁屏解锁助手
name.en: android-unlock

summary.zh: 通过已授权的 ADB 输入普通 PIN 解锁安卓手机，PIN 存在本机钥匙串；不 root、不绕过系统安全。公开版尚未重新做实机测试。
summary.en: Unlocks an Android phone with an ordinary PIN over already-authorised ADB, keeping the PIN in the local Keychain. No root, no bypass. The public build has not been re-tested on a real device.

name.zh: 我和 AI 的对话量
name.en: How much I talk to AI

summary.zh: 把本地留存的 AI 对话记录脱敏汇总成图表：30 天内每天发了多少条、写了多少字。只含数字，不含对话内容。
summary.en: A de-identified chart of my local AI chat history: messages and characters per day over 30 days. Numbers only, no conversation content.

name.zh: 机票好价监控
name.en: Flight deal monitor

summary.zh: 定时巡检日本周末往返航班，并汇总小红书机票博主的特价帖，每天生成一份网页报告。
summary.en: A scheduled job that checks weekend round trips to Japan and collects fare posts from Xiaohongshu deal-hunters, producing a daily web report.

name.zh: GPT-6.1 Terra 鹈鹕测试
name.en: GPT-6.1 Terra pelican test

summary.zh: 让 AI 画一只骑自行车的鹈鹕，记录下这三个版本的结果。
summary.en: Three versions of an AI-drawn pelican riding a bicycle.

name.zh: Thorsten Ball：我现在怎么和 Agent 一起写代码
name.en: Thorsten Ball on working with coding agents

summary.zh: Amp 工程师的 15 条编码 Agent 用法：用最强模型、让 Agent 看到完整开发流程、要求拿出证据、只审高风险代码；附评论区补充。
summary.en: Fifteen tips from an Amp engineer: use the strongest model, let the agent see the whole dev loop, demand evidence, review only high-risk code. With notes from the replies.

name.zh: 工资会全面改发数字人民币吗？
name.en: Will salaries move to the digital yuan?

summary.zh: 核对“2026／2027 年大部分公司改发数字人民币工资”的传闻：部分地区和单位确有试点，没有查到全国统一改发的文件；附计息、转回银行卡和隐私方面的区别。
summary.en: Fact-checking the claim that most Chinese employers will pay wages in e-CNY by 2026/27: local pilots are real, no nationwide mandate was found. Plus how it differs on interest, withdrawals and privacy.

name.zh: AI 写代码后，谁来审？
name.en: Who reviews AI-written code?

summary.zh: Addy Osmani 介绍 Claude Code 团队的审查流程：常规找错交给自动检查，人只看方向、架构和高风险改动，再靠快速回滚兜底。
summary.en: Addy Osmani on the Claude Code team's review flow: automated checks catch routine bugs, people focus on direction, architecture and risky changes, and fast rollback is the safety net.

name.zh: 《八观识人》视频文字导读
name.en: Eight ways of reading people: video notes

summary.zh: 把一段约 9 分钟的识人视频整理成带时间点的分章导读，区分观察角度与讲者判断，附原视频和中文字幕入口；非逐字稿。
summary.en: Timestamped notes on a nine-minute video about reading people, separating observations from the speaker’s judgments, with links to the video and Chinese captions. Not a verbatim transcript.

name.zh: Arc、Phi、Ardia：基础浏览体验对比
name.en: Arc vs Phi vs Ardia

summary.zh: 不看 AI 功能，只比侧栏、置顶、分屏和同步：重视多层侧栏目录选 Phi，要 Chromium 配套和三窗格可以试 Ardia。
summary.en: Ignoring AI features and comparing sidebars, pinning, split view and sync: Phi for nested sidebar folders, Ardia for Chromium extras and three-pane split.

name.zh: 英语听说三步练习法
name.en: Three steps to English listening and speaking

summary.zh: 把一段英语学习视频整理成听、想、说三步练法，附每天 25 分钟安排，并分开标出作者原话、本页建议和不靠谱的说法。
summary.en: A video's listen–think–speak method turned into a 25-minute daily routine, marking what the author said, what this page suggests, and which claims don't hold up.

name.zh: 李录这场对谈，究竟讲了什么
name.en: What Li Lu actually said at Columbia

summary.zh: 2026 年哥大格雷厄姆—多德午餐会上李录对谈的中文导读：价值投资、AI 和中国经济用的是同一套判断标准。
summary.en: A Chinese guide to Li Lu's 2026 Graham & Dodd talk at Columbia, where one yardstick covers value investing, AI and China's economy.

name.zh: 原始积累的 5 条建议｜视频精读
name.en: Five rules for building early savings

summary.zh: 一期 29 分钟视频的精读：认真工作攒结余，把结余变成长期资产，用真实账目判断离“少依赖工资”还有多远。
summary.en: Notes on a 29-minute video: earn a surplus, turn it into long-term assets, and use real numbers to see how far you are from depending less on a salary.

name.zh: WHOOP、Oura 还是 Apple Watch
name.en: WHOOP, Oura or Apple Watch

summary.zh: 按人民币算三款健康穿戴的总成本，并汇总真实用户口碑：用 iPhone、能每天充电就先选 Apple Watch。
summary.en: Total cost in RMB and real-user feedback for three health wearables. On iPhone and fine with daily charging? Start with Apple Watch.

name.zh: iCTRL、ios-use、iphone-use：怎么选
name.en: Choosing an iPhone control tool for agents

summary.zh: 三款让 Agent 操作真机 iPhone 的工具：无线跨设备选 iCTRL，固定批处理选 ios-use，要完整工作台看 iphone-use；附许可和安全边界。
summary.en: Three tools that let agents drive a real iPhone: iCTRL for wireless use, ios-use for scripted batches, iphone-use for a full workbench. With licence and security notes.

name.zh: 我如何使用 Hermes Agent
name.en: How I use Hermes Agent

summary.zh: 把 Hermes 当成个人 AI 中枢的日常用法：协调项目、把代码交给 Codex、管理 NAS、做旅行研究、调度 Cloudflare 和多台设备。
summary.en: How I use Hermes as a personal AI hub: coordinating projects, handing code to Codex, running the NAS, travel research, Cloudflare and multiple devices.

name.zh: 私有微信行动与事实索引：架构设计
name.en: A private WeChat action index: architecture

summary.zh: 在本机给自己的微信记录建一个可追溯的待办与事实索引：受控解密、来源可回查、原子写入。这是设计稿，不是运行验收。
summary.en: Design notes for a local, traceable index of to-dos and facts from my own WeChat history: controlled decryption, source tracing and atomic writes. A design, not a tested system.

name.zh: AirPods 头部追踪在 Mac 上能怎么玩
name.en: What AirPods head tracking can do on a Mac

summary.zh: 整理 HeadOrbit、CoreMotion 接口和社区玩法：飞行模拟头瞄、免手切歌、光标控制、坐姿提醒。
summary.en: A round-up of HeadOrbit, the CoreMotion API and community ideas: head-aim in flight sims, hands-free track skipping, cursor control and posture reminders.

name.zh: 高能量中文播客清单与评论区拆解
name.en: High-energy Chinese podcasts, unpacked

summary.zh: 汇总 4 部被推荐的中文长访谈，附评论区的批评意见，以及一段 3 分钟双人浓缩播客。
summary.en: Four recommended long-form Chinese interviews, the critical takes from the replies, and a 3-minute two-voice summary episode.

name.zh: 三脚架怎么选：节数、结构与品牌
name.en: Choosing a tripod: sections, design and brands

summary.zh: 3、4、5 节怎么选，要不要中轴，以及富图宝、马小路、巅峰、思锐、徕图的定位和参考价。
summary.en: Three vs four vs five sections, centre column or not, and where Fotopro, Marsace, Peak Design, Sirui and Leofoto sit, with reference prices.

name.zh: 出境自驾带什么泡面
name.en: Instant noodles for an overseas road trip

summary.zh: 出境自驾的袋装泡面清单：好收纳、口味稳，以及海关申报要注意什么。
summary.en: A packet-noodle list for a road trip abroad: easy to pack, reliable flavours, and what to watch for at customs.

name.zh: 香港转机 8 小时：烧鹅与 ifc
name.en: An 8-hour Hong Kong layover

summary.zh: 8 小时转机出机场吃甘棠烧鹅、逛香港站和 ifc 的路线，附东涌备选和来不及时的返程边界。
summary.en: Leaving the airport on an 8-hour layover for roast goose, Hong Kong Station and ifc, with a Tung Chung fallback and a hard turn-back time.

name.zh: 墨尔本小火车 × 企鹅归巢
name.en: Puffing Billy and the Phillip Island penguins

summary.zh: 墨尔本一日行程的图文速查：Puffing Billy 小火车、转场时间、拍照机会，以及企鹅保护区的拍摄限制。
summary.en: A visual cheat sheet for a Melbourne day trip: Puffing Billy, transfer timing, photo spots and the camera rules at the penguin parade.

name.zh: 五一去宿务：机票、玩法与路线
name.en: Cebu for a May Day break

summary.zh: 比较上海、杭州、香港出发的五一航班，整理墨宝、卡瓦山、薄荷岛玩法和短假路线。
summary.en: Comparing May Day flights from Shanghai, Hangzhou and Hong Kong, plus Moalboal, Kawasan, Bohol and a short-break route.

name.zh: 微软“6 万人自愿离职”到底是什么
name.en: What Microsoft's 60,000-person exit offer really is

summary.zh: 6 万是有资格申请自愿离职的人数，不是裁员人数；拆开官方内部信和媒体补充的范围、补偿、期限与背后的 AI 基建成本。
summary.en: 60,000 is the number eligible for a voluntary exit offer, not a layoff count. What the internal memo and press reports say about scope, terms, deadlines and AI capex.

name.zh: 邵艾伦 × 孙宇晨：四小时访谈值得带走什么
name.en: Four hours with Sun Yuchen: what's worth keeping

summary.zh: 把口号和方法拆开：持续记录、扩大选项、小步行动、根据反馈修正值得学；医学、投资和财富相关说法要打折扣。附时间导航。
summary.en: Separating slogans from method: keep records, widen options, act in small steps and adjust. Claims about health, investing and wealth need a discount. With a timestamp guide.

name.zh: 新西兰南岛自驾：先看图再上路
name.en: Driving New Zealand's South Island, in pictures

summary.zh: 手机上看的视觉学习卡：靠左行驶、环岛、单车道桥、限速与黄线、租车保险要问的问题，以及出发当天该查的路况入口。
summary.en: Phone-sized visual cards: keeping left, roundabouts, one-lane bridges, speed limits and yellow lines, rental insurance questions, and where to check road conditions on the day.

name.zh: AI 怎么操作浏览器：八种方案的白话解读
name.en: How AI operates a browser: eight approaches explained

summary.zh: 沿陈大黄原文的八条路线，讲清脚本、控制接口、浏览器插件、原生 Agent 浏览器、自主操作、云端浏览器、专业采集和 WebMCP 的用途、区别与短板。
summary.en: A plain-language reading of Chen Dahuang's eight browser automation approaches, from scripts and extensions to autonomous agents, cloud browsers, extraction and WebMCP.

name.zh: 全屋 DNS 拦截：哪些能拦，哪些别拦
name.en: Home DNS blocking: what to block and what to leave alone

summary.zh: 用一台 AdGuard Home 一天的拦截数据，配上 Apple、Android 和国产推送的官方放行清单：哪些统计和上报可以挡，推送、联网检测、证书校验为什么别碰，以及 DNS 拦不住的信息流广告。
summary.en: One day of AdGuard Home data plus Apple, Android and Chinese push-service docs: which telemetry is safe to block, why push, connectivity checks and certificate validation should stay open, and what DNS can't stop.
